author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

On a Yunnan dining table, there is always a place for a fragrant, spicy sauce.

Some sauces come from mountain fruits, while others are made with chilies, fermented black beans, and all kinds of spices. Washing, drying, pounding, stir-frying, and simmering—each step takes time, but the result is always the most appetizing companion to a meal.

This time, I’ve gathered together the sauces I’ve made over the years into one collection. From ingredients to methods, from the kitchen to the dining table, let’s take a look at those Yunnan homemade sauces that become more fragrant over time and more unforgettable with every bite.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
